data.name: Zephyra
data.gender_notes: Zephyra is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek god Zephyrus, the god of the west wind. In Greek mythology, he was known for carrying sweet scents and gentle breezes. His arrival often signified spring, new beginnings, and life renewal. The name Zephyra carries the meaning “West Wind” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Zephyra usually hope their child will grow to embody west wind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes fresh beginnings, renewal, and gentle blessings.
data.etymology: Zephyra belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “West Wind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zephyra total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zephyra is a unique name that carries the rich cultural heritage and history of the Greek gods. Naming a child with this name signifies that they will carry the essence of new beginnings, life renewal, and gentle blessings.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Zephyra can be seen as a representation of the Holy Spirit, who brings new life and renewed hope through the gentle breeze of His presence and blessings. This name can serve as a reminder for the child to always seek the guidance and comfort of the Holy Spirit in their lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Zephyra is the Greek goddess of the west wind, symbolizing gentle breezes and new beginnings. In Christianity, her name represents the calming presence of the Holy Spirit, bringing renewal and peace.
